review_candidates.title: Senior Azure Engineer
review_candidates.description_excerpt: What You’ll Do Own the architecture, administration, monitoring, troubleshooting, and optimization of the Microsoft Azure environment and Azure Virtual Desktop (AVD) infrastructure. Administer AVD host pools, session hosts, images, autoscaling, FSLogix profiles, application delivery, and Nerdio. Lead infrastructure projects, system upgrades, patching, incident response, and root-cause analysis to maintain operational stability. Maintain technical documentation, architecture diagrams, operational
review_candidates.requirements_excerpt: The ideal candidate is a highly technical, hands-on Azure expert who can independently manage enterprise cloud infrastructure, lead infrastructure projects, and provide technical guidance to a junior engineer. What We’re Looking For 8+ years of infrastructure or systems engineering experience, including at least 5 years of hands-on Microsoft Azure engineering in production environments. Deep expertise in Azure compute, networking, storage, identity, security, monitoring, backup, disaster recovery, and governance. Proficiency in PowerShell scripting, infrastructure automation, and operational process improvement. Nice to Have Hands-on experience with Nerdio for AVD management and optimization.
